strings.app.missingScript: run-script needs the file of a script.
strings.app.usage:
Usage:
  {program} [<folder.slproj>]
      opens the window, with the project of the folder if given
  {program} --python [arguments of python]
      runs the embedded Python with the stresslab module attached to a new document: -m module, -c code, a script or the interactive prompt
  {program} --headless [options] run-script <file.py> [arguments of the script]
      runs a script without the window: loads the modules, runs the script on a new document, writes the log to the standard output
      --extensions <folder>   installs the modules in the subfolders of the folder; may repeat
      --profile <file>        enables the modules of the profile; without it all installed modules are enabled
      --journal <file.slpy>   writes the journal of the session
      --log-level <level>     trace, debug, info, warning, error, critical or off; without it the setting log.level
      --log-file <file>       also writes the log to the file
      exit code: 0 success, n after sys.exit(n), 1 an error in the script, 2 a wrong command line
  {program} --version
      prints the version
strings.diff.mesh.same: rebuilt (the same number of nodes and elements)
strings.extension.crashed: Module “{module}” stopped working and was restarted. The model is intact: the command it was running is cancelled.

extension.gaveUp.one: Module “{module}” stopped working {count} time in a row and is not restarted any more. The model is intact. Disable and enable the module to try again.
extension.gaveUp.other: Module “{module}” stopped working {count} times in a row and is not restarted any more. The model is intact. Disable and enable the module to try again.

strings.extension.hung: Module “{module}” stopped responding and was restarted. The model is intact: the command it was running is cancelled.
